The reported configuration: schema-only inline retrieval + global re-consolidation, cross-encoder rerank on the relation side, two-call consolidation with generalize. Every ablation is measured against it.

REPAIR of art2 in the gemini staged arm. It truncated twice: first with thinking uncapped (62,912 thinking / 2,610 answer, stopped at the model's 65,536 ceiling), then at a 24,576 cap (8,189 / 16,371). art2 is the biggest article in the set — 135 entities feed its reification — so it needs the model's full output budget WITH thinking capped, or reasoning eats the answer. nb7b then grafts it onto the finished 20-article vocabulary: fresh=false so the vocabulary survives, inline vocab so it reuses existing terms, consolidate=false because a fresh pass would overwrite the cumulative merge report and strand the other 19 articles.

repaired.why: A one-article repair run (configs/art2-fix.json) re-used this run_tag, so begin() replaced this stage's finished record and left it open, claiming one article. Rebuilt from the files on disk: outputs re-scanned, articles restored to the run's 20, metrics re-derived by run_metrics over all 20.
repaired.fixed_in_code: run_manifest.begin() now archives a superseded finished record under 'attempts' instead of dropping it.

type_refresh.why: nb4's refresh_ext_after_consolidation read the e2e field names on staged entity records, so the type consolidation never reached the per-article data (its report said 0 nodes changed). Replayed over the files on disk; type fields only, relation consolidation verified unchanged. Metrics re-derived after.
type_refresh.fixed_in_code: nb4 cell 23 now resolves vocab_id/chosen_type via _FIELD_ALIAS.
